parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

✨
aroma[əˈroʊmə]n.
An aroma is a scent or smell. (mùi thơm, hương vị)
👉 I love the aroma of coffee in the morning.
✨
beverage[ˈbɛvərɪdʒ]n.
A beverage is a drink. (đồ uống, thức uống)
👉 The waiter brought our beverages first. Then he brought our food.
✨
cluster[ˈklʌstər]n.
A cluster of things is a small group of them placed close together. (đám, chùm, cụm)
👉 She held a large cluster of grapes in her hand.
✨
combine[kəmˈbaɪn]v.
To combine is to join together to make a single thing or group. (kết hợp, phối hợp)
👉 Mina combined peanut butter and jelly to make a sandwich.
✨
condensed[kənˈdɛnst]adj.
When a liquid is condensed, it is made thicker. (đặc, cô đặc)
👉 One way to make a dessert thick and sweet is to use condensed milk.
✨
contemporary[kənˈtɛmpəˌrɛri]adj.
When something is contemporary, it is related to the present time. (đương đại, hiện đại)
👉 Contemporary scientists have learned quite a bit about DNA.
✨
cultivate[ˈkʌltəˌveɪt]v.
To cultivate plants is to care for them and help them grow. (trồng trọt, canh tác)
👉 A research company is cultivating new kinds of rice to aid poor countries.
✨
divine[dɪˈvaɪn]adj.
When something is divine, it is related to gods. (thần thánh, thiêng liêng)
👉 Legends say that music was given to men as a divine gift from the gods.
✨
humid[ˈhjumɪd]adj.
When it is humid, there is a lot of water in the air. (ẩm ướt, ẩm)
👉 It is very humid inside of a sauna.
✨
odor[ˈoʊdər]n.
An odor is a very distinct smell. (mùi, mùi đặc trưng)
👉 He knew there was a leak when he noticed the strong odor of natural gas.
✨
palate[ˈpælət]n.
The palate is the top part of the mouth. (vòm miệng, khẩu vị)
👉 You can touch your palate with your tongue.
✨
paradise[ˈpærəˌdaɪs]n.
Paradise is the place or condition of happiness where things are perfect. (thiên đường)
👉 My vacation in Hawaii was like being in paradise.
✨
plantation[plænˈteɪʃən]n.
A plantation is a big farm that only grows certain kinds of crops. (đồn điền, khu đất trồng trọt)
👉 In the 1800s, there were many cotton plantations in the southern US.
✨
rapid[ˈræpɪd]adj.
When something is rapid, it moves or changes very quickly. (nhanh, nhanh chóng)
👉 His mother was surprised by her son’s rapid growth.
✨
rate[reɪt]n.
A rate is the speed at which something happens. (tốc độ, tỉ lệ)
👉 Grass tends to grow at a very slow rate.
✨
soothing[ˈsuðɪŋ]adj.
When something is soothing, it makes you calm or relaxed. (dịu dàng, êm dịu, dễ chịu)
👉 The soothing music helped the baby fall asleep.
✨
subtle[ˈsʌtəl]adj.
When something is subtle, it is not easy to see or notice. (tinh tế, phảng phất, tế nhị)
👉 The handsome man has a subtle smile.
✨
texture[ˈtɛksʧər]n.
The texture of something is the way its surface looks and feels. (kết cấu, bề mặt)
👉 The texture of a rock found in the water is typically very smooth.
✨
toxic[ˈtɑksɪk]adj.
When something is toxic, it is poisonous. Toxic things are very dangerous. (độc hại, có độc)
👉 Please check the label to see if the product is toxic.
✨
vary[ˈvɛri]v.
To vary means to be different from another thing in size or amount. (thay đổi, biến đổi, khác nhau)
👉 The heights of the people in my class vary by a large amount.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the word that is the better fit for each blank.

questions.content: The population growth in the city was incredibly ________.
questions.explanation: 'rapid' (nhanh chóng) là tính từ phù hợp để mô tả sự gia tăng dân số.

questions.content: It is quite surprising that people settled there at such a fast ________.
questions.explanation: 'rate' (tốc độ) phù hợp với cụm từ 'at a fast rate' (với một tốc độ nhanh).

questions.content: Many ________ laws make it illegal for business to compete in unfair ways.
questions.explanation: 'contemporary' (đương đại/hiện đại) là tính từ bổ nghĩa cho 'laws'.

questions.content: However, the specific laws in different countries ________ greatly.
questions.explanation: 'vary' (khác nhau) là động từ chính của câu.

questions.content: Because it is quite ________ on the island, various kinds of plants grow well there.
questions.explanation: 'humid' (ẩm ướt) phù hợp với điều kiện khí hậu trên đảo.

questions.content: However, some of these plants are ________ to humans.
questions.explanation: 'toxic' (có độc) đi kèm với 'to humans' (đối với con người).

questions.content: The cheese has a smooth ________.
questions.explanation: 'texture' (kết cấu) phù hợp với tính từ 'smooth' (mịn màng).

questions.content: However, some people find it hard to eat because of its powerful ________.
questions.explanation: 'aroma' (mùi hương) phù hợp với 'powerful' (mạnh mẽ/nồng).

questions.content: A ________ of people suggested that nearby cities could fight the invaders if they cooperated with each other.
questions.explanation: 'A cluster of people' (một nhóm người).

questions.content: As a result, everyone ________ their efforts and defeated the invaders.
questions.explanation: 'combined' (kết hợp) là động từ phù hợp cho hành động kết hợp nỗ lực.

questions.content: The artist uses ________ differences of color in her landscapes.
questions.explanation: 'subtle differences' (những sự khác biệt tinh tế).

questions.content: This has an overall calming and ________ effect on the viewer.
questions.explanation: 'soothing effect' (tác dụng êm dịu), đồng nghĩa với 'calming'.

questions.content: A huge garden was ________ in the middle of the city.
questions.explanation: 'cultivated' (được trồng trọt) là dạng bị động phù hợp ở đây.

questions.content: However, a species of rare plants gave off an unpleasant ________.
questions.explanation: 'unpleasant odor' (mùi khó chịu).

questions.content: During a four or five course meal, one should drink something to clean the ________ between courses.
questions.explanation: 'clean the palate' (làm sạch vòm miệng/khẩu vị) là một cụm từ phổ biến.

questions.content: The perfect ________ for this is, of course, water.
questions.explanation: 'beverage' (thức uống) ám chỉ nước trong câu này.

questions.content: I can explain the basic story in a simple, ________ way.
questions.explanation: 'condensed way' (cách tóm tắt/ngắn gọn).

questions.content: A boy is given a ________ message, and he begins an exciting adventure.
questions.explanation: 'divine message' (thông điệp từ thần linh).

questions.content: The island of Oahu is not a natural ________ like Maui.
questions.explanation: 'natural paradise' (thiên đường tự nhiên).

questions.content: However, tourists still visit its many ________.
questions.explanation: 'plantations' (đồn điền) là danh từ số nhiều phù hợp.

sections.title: Exercise 2 Part A: Match the phrases to make complete sentences.

questions.content: A soothing cup of tea ________.
options: is good for a sore throat
was too strong to be enjoyable
questions.explanation: Một tách trà dịu nhẹ rất tốt cho bệnh đau họng.

questions.content: The odor of the cheese ________.
options: was too strong to be enjoyable
questions.explanation: Mùi của pho mát quá nồng nên không thấy ngon.

questions.content: The pot's texture ________.
options: is good for a sore throat
covered almost a third of the country
the shoulder of Taurus the Bull
questions.explanation: Bề mặt của cái nồi cảm giác rất mịn.

questions.content: The chemical is toxic ________.
options: several species of flowers as a hobby
questions.explanation: Hóa chất này độc hại đối với côn trùng và động vật nhỏ.

questions.content: The contemporary fiction class ________.
options: is good for a sore throat
the shoulder of Taurus the Bull
questions.explanation: Lớp học văn học hư cấu đương đại bao gồm các tác phẩm từ thế kỷ 21.

questions.content: The rate at which these flowers grew ________.
options: covered almost a third of the country
questions.explanation: Tốc độ lớn lên của những bông hoa này nhanh đến kinh ngạc.

questions.content: My mother cultivates ________.
options: several species of flowers as a hobby
the shoulder of Taurus the Bull
questions.explanation: Mẹ tôi trồng trọt một vài loài hoa như một sở thích.

questions.content: The plantation had ________.
options: covered almost a third of the country
was too strong to be enjoyable
questions.explanation: Đồn điền này có hai mươi công nhân trồng bông.

questions.content: The thick and humid forest ________.
options: covered almost a third of the country
the shoulder of Taurus the Bull
questions.explanation: Khu rừng dày đặc và ẩm ướt bao phủ gần một phần ba diện tích quốc gia.

questions.content: That cluster of stars in the sky makes ________.
options: several species of flowers as a hobby
the shoulder of Taurus the Bull
is good for a sore throat
questions.explanation: Cụm sao trên bầu trời tạo thành vai của chòm sao Kim Ngưu (Taurus the Bull).

sections.title: Exercise 2 Part B: Match the clauses to make complete sentences.

questions.content: The scientists wanted to find a cure for the sickness, ________.
options: but the condensed version was shorter
and Jim thought it was a divine message
questions.explanation: Các nhà khoa học muốn tìm cách chữa trị căn bệnh, vì vậy họ đã kết hợp các hóa chất.

questions.content: He offered to share his water, ________.
options: but I wanted my own beverage
the effects of the medicine will vary
and she smelled the aroma of cookies
questions.explanation: Anh ấy đề nghị chia sẻ nước của mình, nhưng tôi muốn thức uống của riêng tôi.

questions.content: I prefer mocha to coffee ________.
options: and she looked at his palate
because it has a subtle taste of chocolate
but the condensed version was shorter
and Jim thought it was a divine message
questions.explanation: Tôi thích mocha hơn cà phê vì nó có hương vị sô cô la thoang thoảng.

questions.content: Many new jobs were created, ________.
options: the effects of the medicine will vary
questions.explanation: Nhiều việc làm mới được tạo ra, nên sự tăng trưởng kinh tế rất nhanh.

questions.content: The report was ten pages long, ________.
options: and she smelled the aroma of cookies
but the condensed version was shorter
and Jim thought it was a divine message
questions.explanation: Bản báo cáo dài 10 trang, nhưng phiên bản tóm tắt thì ngắn hơn.

questions.content: The doctor asked him to open his mouth, ________.
options: and she looked at his palate
but I wanted my own beverage
questions.explanation: Bác sĩ yêu cầu anh ấy mở miệng, và bà ấy nhìn vào vòm miệng của anh.

questions.content: She walked in the door, ________.
options: because it has a subtle taste of chocolate
and she smelled the aroma of cookies
the effects of the medicine will vary
questions.explanation: Cô ấy bước qua cửa, và ngửi thấy mùi thơm của bánh quy.

questions.content: Because the island is so warm and beautiful, ________.
options: but the condensed version was shorter
and Jim thought it was a divine message
and she looked at his palate
questions.explanation: Vì hòn đảo quá ấm áp và xinh đẹp, mọi người gọi nó là một thiên đường.

questions.content: Because patients’ bodies are so different, ________.
options: the effects of the medicine will vary
and she smelled the aroma of cookies
questions.explanation: Vì cơ thể của các bệnh nhân rất khác nhau, nên tác dụng của thuốc sẽ khác nhau.

questions.content: It didn’t rain all summer, ________.
options: and Jim thought it was a divine message
but the condensed version was shorter
questions.explanation: Trời không mưa suốt mùa hè, và Jim nghĩ đó là một thông điệp từ thần linh.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The History of Chocolate

Many people believe that chocolate originally came from Europe. However, chocolate, called the "food of the gods," was first made in the Americas. The first chocolate was very different from contemporary chocolate.

Wild chocolate trees can grow easily in the humid Amazon rainforest. Clusters of flowers growing on these trees turn to seeds. About 20 to 60 cacao beans can be found in the seeds. Cacao beans are the ingredient needed to create sweet, soothing, and delicious chocolate treats.

The Mayan and Aztec cultures both thought that chocolate trees were brought from paradise by gods. The Mayans and Aztecs used the beans from this divine tree to create a special beverage with a very pleasant odor. Surprisingly, the Aztecs believed that it would be toxic to women and children.

In the 1500s, the Spanish explorer Cortes met the Aztecs. Cortes became quite interested in the plantations where the Aztecs cultivated chocolate trees. When he returned to Europe, he took cacao beans with him. He introduced the people of Spain to the Aztecs’ chocolate beverage.

Over the next 100 years or so, kings, queens, and members of the upper class enjoyed drinking chocolate. They enjoyed it even more once they learned to add sugar to the beverage! Soon, chocolate had spread all across Europe. New machines allowed chocolate makers to perfect their products and produce them at a very rapid rate. Preparing the beans in special ways brought out the aroma of chocolate. The beans were combined with condensed milk to give the chocolate a smooth texture.

Today, contemporary chocolates with subtle flavors fill the shelves of expensive chocolate shops. The different types of chocolate available today vary widely. True chocolate lovers can tell which is best, though. They will tell you that the flavor of high quality chocolate stays on the palate long after you finish it.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension Part A: True or False

questions.content: Wild chocolate trees grow well in humid weather.
questions.explanation: Cây sô cô la hoang dã phát triển tốt trong thời tiết ẩm ướt, điều này đúng theo bài đọc.

questions.content: The Mayans and Aztecs said chocolate was a divine plant brought from paradise.
questions.explanation: Người Maya và Aztec cho rằng cây sô cô la là một loài cây thần thánh được mang đến từ thiên đường.

questions.content: The Mayans cultivated chocolate trees on plantations.
questions.explanation: The Aztecs cultivated chocolate trees on plantations, không phải người Mayans.

questions.content: Beans were combined with condensed milk to give chocolate a smooth texture.
questions.explanation: Hạt cacao được kết hợp với sữa đặc để tạo cho sô cô la có kết cấu mịn màng.

questions.content: The first chocolate beverages were made in Europe.
questions.explanation: Những thức uống sô cô la đầu tiên được làm ra bởi người Maya và Aztec ở châu Mỹ.

questions.content: The different types of chocolate available today vary widely.
questions.explanation: Các loại sô cô la khác nhau có sẵn ngày nay rất đa dạng và khác biệt.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension Part B: Choose the right answer.

questions.content: Which word is NOT used to describe chocolate in the reading?
questions.explanation: 'Aroma' được dùng để nói về mùi thơm của sô cô la, không phải là tính từ trực tiếp mô tả nó như sweet, soothing, delicious.

questions.content: Which of the following did NOT consume chocolate as a beverage?
questions.explanation: Không có chi tiết nào trong bài nói rằng các vị thần của người Maya đã tiêu thụ sô cô la dưới dạng đồ uống.

questions.content: Which group of people believed that chocolate was toxic to women and children?
questions.explanation: Người Aztec tin rằng sô cô la có độc đối với phụ nữ và trẻ em.

questions.content: What allowed chocolate to be produced at a rapid rate?
questions.explanation: Máy móc mới (New machines) đã cho phép các nhà sản xuất làm ra sản phẩm với tốc độ nhanh chóng.
